name: Viscous Starmass
desc: A slimy and rubbery jelly. It sticks to your hands if you touch it, but squeeze it all you like—nothing will make it lose its shape. Despite how it looks, this is a metal, so please don't eat it.

eff.name: Core Boost - Quality
eff.desc1: Boosts quality by [Lv. x 2] when added to a core.

eff.name: Increase Resonance Area - Star
eff.desc1: When used as an ingredient for a star-shaped Alchemy Core, increases the resonance area by [Lv. x 1].
